title: Moving the number-grid key's starting position
question: Do the exact source numeric2 Part B payload phases produce complete-page outputs above its fixed English gate under conditional skips?
reader_question: Does moving the number-grid key help decode a page?
summary: 30,112 short checks select 234 complete-page decodes; none clears the source English-score bar. The new grid extends the earlier zero-start payload test with bounded nonzero phases.
finding: Unchanged source Part B: 30,112 short screens, 234 full confirmations, no source-selected output >−5.5. Best −6.360651245809504 on LP2-49, reversed majority payload, sign −1, Atbash, offset 23. All 30,346 scores independently checked and 234 full paths reconstructed. Separate post-target audit: 34,827 terminal candidates, no >−5.5 crossings. Controls: 1,616 eligible, all score gates pass, 1,540 exact readings, 76 higher-cumulative alternatives; all true readings retained at ranks 2–5.
reader_finding: None of the 234 complete-page results passed the source’s English-score test. The strongest result was on LP2-49; most settings stopped after the first 50 runes.
reader_limit: Only four grid-derived keys and the source’s page-specific starting positions were tested. A good score can select an incorrect reading, and rejected short screens were not decoded as complete pages.
limitations: The known-message controls are decoder cells, not full-search calibration. All 1,616 pass both gates but 76 return a different reading; 20 of those alternatives have worse normalized scores than the retained truth. No full-grid null significance, arbitrary phases, broad language or encryption-family exclusion.
next_steps: Freeze an exact alternate grid interpretation or key clock before testing it, retain known-reading power checks, and require an independently confirmed reading before treating a score as decryption.

scope.representation: 55 exact source GP29 page arrays, LP2-00–49 and LP2-51–55; canonical GP Latin labels scored with the pinned source English quadgrams.
scope.procedure: Run unchanged source numeric2 Part B with four payload interpretations and its page-specific phase bounds. Record every short output and confirm only source short-gate survivors. Independently rescore every output and reconstruct all complete survivors, best short output and best normalized terminal witnesses. Preserve source selection separately from a labelled post-target audit.
scope.parameters: Four source 256-byte streams tiled seven times to 1,792 values. For page length L, offsets range(max(1,268−L)); 1,882 page/offset pairs × four streams × two signs × two Atbash states = 30,112 screens. Screen 50/beam 60/strict >−6.5, survivor full beam 300/strict >−5.5, max three conditional key skips. 880 offset-zero labels overlap earlier payload work; 29,232 nonzero labels.
scope.exclusions: Source numeric2 Parts A/C, phases outside the executable page-length bounds, other payload constructions, clocks, languages, joined pages, full decoding of rejected short screens, general key-family exclusion or global null significance. Earlier offset-zero replay used another width, no short gate and another finite allocation.
